title: the lance speed - the lances join the ladder

banner.title: THE LANCE SPEED FACTORS - the three lances ride the R158 ladder
banner.provenance: R779 left the lance speed contract-side (the R158 ladder names no lance); R780 pins the three printed cells. The PHB p.38 WEAPON TYPES speed column, read from the 1eonline.info compilation (the repo-trusted source): light horse 7, medium horse 6, heavy horse 8. The medium-horse 6 outrunning the light-horse 7 is no OCR slip - both compilation pages print it cell-for-cell, and the engine follows the print exactly as it followed the spear 6-8 spread. The rows land in rules/weaponspeed.h - the R158 name-keyed ladder, still pure data: the DMG p.66 three caller-detected cases (tie order, the extra-attack windows, the weapon-vs-spell segment) gained no engine caller here; the R158 audit itself gains the three checks against the R780 header pins, so a mutant in either the ladder row or the pin dies at the preflight. Honest boundaries: the printed lengths and space-required cells ride no engine concept, and the standing pragma once in weaponspeed.h stays untouched - the R778 guard rule governs new guards only
banner.sentinel: Zero new book pages: the three speed cells ride the 1eonline.info compilation the R189 speed-verify duty already trusts
